description: Complete inventory and mechanical recovery of all Dungeon Siege II alter_generic equipment occurrences

world\\global\\enchantments\\weapon_ench.author: Elijah Emerson

supported_parameters.weapon_ffx: FlickFX played on melee weapons when enchantment is attached / equipped.
supported_parameters.bow_ffx: FlickFX played on bows/crossbows when enchantment is attached / equipped.
supported_parameters.projectile_ffx: FlickFX attached to ammo arrow or thrown item when prepared for attack.
supported_parameters.hit_ffx: FlickFX triggered on target victim when damaged by weapon (OnDamage$).

events_handled: OnDamage$( CustomEffect effect$, Go attacker$, Go victim$, Go weapon$, float damage$ )
world\\global\\enchantments\\weapon_ench.combat_damage_or_healing: None (0.0). Pure visual / audio presentation wrapper for weapon attachments and impact particles.
world\\global\\enchantments\\weapon_ench.stacking: Single instance per equipped weapon; destroyed on unequip.
world\\global\\enchantments\\weapon_ench.target: Weapon wielder, equipped weapon mesh, projectile ammo, and hit victim.
world\\global\\enchantments\\weapon_ench.cooldown_or_probability: 100% on hit for hit_ffx; continuous loop for weapon_ffx / bow_ffx.

none_static_stat_descriptor.mechanics: UI description placeholder for +5% Range. The underlying weapon (wpn_a1_vet_crafted_9) statically defines attack_range = 11.0 (vs base 10.0 elven longbow). The alter_generic modifier with description '+5% Range' displays on the item tooltip without executing any script.
none_static_stat_descriptor.combat_damage_or_healing: None directly from alteration; weapon attack_range is statically baked in the [attack] block.

none_quest_cipher_descriptor.mechanics: Riddle cipher clue text for the secret 'Mysterious Mystery' quest. Set tiers 1, 2, and 3 display numeric sequence descriptions ('5 2 6 4 3 9 2 8', '3 11 7', '6 10 1 2 7') which map to the letter cipher from the Mysterious Book ('FROM VEX QUIT') unlocking Chant 75 (obj_ch_kl_lc / 'Columnarius Sectorus').
